name: API PA
subject: Celebrating Immigrant Heritage Month & Fighting for Our Future | June Newsletter
body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
As we celebrate Immigrant Heritage Month, I've been reflecting on my own family's story.
I was born in the Philippines. My father served in the US Navy and when I was 9 years old, my family came to the United States looking for opportunity, stability, and a future.
But because of a lost visa and a broken immigration system, my family was separated from my older brother for 10 years. Ten years of missed birthdays, holidays, and moments we'll never get back.
My family followed every rule. My father served in the U.S. Navy for 20 years. We did everything we were told was the "right way." Yet the system still tore our family apart.
That's why Immigrant Heritage Month is about more than celebrating where we come from. It's also about fighting for the families who are still facing separation, detention, and fear today.
At API PA, we know that immigrant communities have always helped build this country. Our stories, our labor, and our dreams are part of what makes America strong. That's why we're continuing to organize for an immigration system rooted in dignity, justice, and keeping families together. This month, I hope you'll join us in turning our stories into action. Together, we can build the power needed to protect our communities and create a future where no family has to endure what mine did.
In solidarity,
James Delos Reyes
Co-Field Director
API PA
Election Results
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/82704/images/05.16.2026%20Canvassing-2.jpg]
This primary election, our members showed what it looks like to build real Asian American political power.
Together, we made 428,000+ calls in 22 languages, knocked 8,500 doors in 6 languages, and staffed polling locations with 15 pollstanders who spoke 13 languages. Through these efforts, we helped elect Chris Rabb to Congress while ensuring Asian American voters had the information they needed to make their voices heard.
None of this happened by accident. It happened because our members organized, volunteered, and worked together across communities and languages to protect our neighborhoods and build a future where Asian Americans have a seat at the table. If you're inspired by what we've accomplished together, we invite you to become a member of API PA. Join us as we continue building the power our communities need to win lasting change.
Become a member! [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/small-business?contactdata=yGJfV1IkXVNoq0ACn1FjCfSuob7+ph4p6e8Q8wS8Jxj5Q003RjVFc2NsW/DNc5+Z64ZgiegraUOaYfZilr6TPMVvvZysHsY1xyHodlpnGagskCoBCqqtynIXe7yg8aAjmDaV3ZyoqN/SFZU2/P/jSjlHTB45LhbvKldc7ulQqec=]
Protecting Philly Small Businesses
https://www.instagram.com/p/DZK1FldgXLj/ [https://www.instagram.com/p/DZK1FldgXLj/] For months, we've been talking with small business owners across Philadelphia about the challenges they face and the changes they need to thrive. One issue we've heard about again and again is the Business Income and Receipts Tax (BIRT), which places an outsized burden on many neighborhood businesses.
While the City Council did not vote on proposed BIRT reforms this spring, our work isn't stopping. We're continuing to organize alongside small business owners, workers, and community members to build support for meaningful changes that help local businesses succeed while strengthening our neighborhoods.
Sign our petition to stay updated with this campaign and find how you can get involved.
Sign the Petition [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/membership]
Ending collaboration with ICE in Dauphin County
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/82704/images/05.05.2026%20Dauphin%20Welcoming%20County%20Group%20Photo.jpg]
Everyone deserves to feel safe accessing county services, sending their children to school, visiting a doctor, or reporting a crime without fear that their personal information could be shared with immigration authorities. That's why we're organizing to pass a Welcoming County Resolution in Dauphin County.
This policy would ensure that county employees and agencies do not share personal information with immigration enforcement without a judicial warrant, prohibit the county from leasing facilities to immigration agencies, and prevent county officials from assisting ICE, CBP, or other immigration enforcement agencies without a warrant signed by a federal judge.
Over the coming months, we'll be working alongside community members, immigrant families, and local leaders to urge the Dauphin County Commissioners to adopt this important policy and make Dauphin County a place where all residents are treated with dignity and respect.

API PA
PO Box 22611
Philadelphia, PA 19110
United States

Hi Peter,
As we celebrate Immigrant Heritage Month, I've been reflecting on my own family's story.
I was born in the Philippines. My father served in the US Navy and when I was 9 years old, my family came to the United States looking for opportunity, stability, and a future.
But because of a lost visa and a broken immigration system, my family was separated from my older brother for 10 years. Ten years of missed birthdays, holidays, and moments we'll never get back.
My family followed every rule. My father served in the U.S. Navy for 20 years. We did everything we were told was the "right way." Yet the system still tore our family apart.
That's why Immigrant Heritage Month is about more than celebrating where we come from. It's also about fighting for the families who are still facing separation, detention, and fear today.
At API PA, we know that immigrant communities have always helped build this country. Our stories, our labor, and our dreams are part of what makes America strong. That's why we're continuing to organize for an immigration system rooted in dignity, justice, and keeping families together. This month, I hope you'll join us in turning our stories into action. Together, we can build the power needed to protect our communities and create a future where no family has to endure what mine did.
In solidarity,
James Delos Reyes
Co-Field Director
API PA
Election Results
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/82704/images/05.16.2026%20Canvassing-2.jpg]
This primary election, our members showed what it looks like to build real Asian American political power.
Together, we made 428,000+ calls in 22 languages, knocked 8,500 doors in 6 languages, and staffed polling locations with 15 pollstanders who spoke 13 languages. Through these efforts, we helped elect Chris Rabb to Congress while ensuring Asian American voters had the information they needed to make their voices heard.
None of this happened by accident. It happened because our members organized, volunteered, and worked together across communities and languages to protect our neighborhoods and build a future where Asian Americans have a seat at the table. If you're inspired by what we've accomplished together, we invite you to become a member of API PA. Join us as we continue building the power our communities need to win lasting change.
Become a member! [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/small-business?contactdata=xo/eqO4uuoJ9CX++FooiboZBgaD8SXTn7Pde+KZjDEf4bB/gMiWz7wFKidVmU5EiODvl0Bd9aOtEKlRgSLkB1GIuCKxiN629EjwBYE38KzCtr+qL996i1zQgHQnhNl28kLeUs7kO4VvC+4ZQyanpqix/uOUEtP3bnRS19UeCHG8=]
Protecting Philly Small Businesses
https://www.instagram.com/p/DZK1FldgXLj/ [https://www.instagram.com/p/DZK1FldgXLj/] For months, we've been talking with small business owners across Philadelphia about the challenges they face and the changes they need to thrive. One issue we've heard about again and again is the Business Income and Receipts Tax (BIRT), which places an outsized burden on many neighborhood businesses.
While the City Council did not vote on proposed BIRT reforms this spring, our work isn't stopping. We're continuing to organize alongside small business owners, workers, and community members to build support for meaningful changes that help local businesses succeed while strengthening our neighborhoods.
Sign our petition to stay updated with this campaign and find how you can get involved.
Sign the Petition [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/membership]
Ending collaboration with ICE in Dauphin County
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/82704/images/05.05.2026%20Dauphin%20Welcoming%20County%20Group%20Photo.jpg]
Everyone deserves to feel safe accessing county services, sending their children to school, visiting a doctor, or reporting a crime without fear that their personal information could be shared with immigration authorities. That's why we're organizing to pass a Welcoming County Resolution in Dauphin County.
This policy would ensure that county employees and agencies do not share personal information with immigration enforcement without a judicial warrant, prohibit the county from leasing facilities to immigration agencies, and prevent county officials from assisting ICE, CBP, or other immigration enforcement agencies without a warrant signed by a federal judge.
Over the coming months, we'll be working alongside community members, immigrant families, and local leaders to urge the Dauphin County Commissioners to adopt this important policy and make Dauphin County a place where all residents are treated with dignity and respect.

API PA
PO Box 22611
Philadelphia, PA 19110
United States

As a Californian, I’m beyond excited to see the Central Valley get one step closer to the representation it deserves and has been missing for far too long in Washington. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Look, this was no guarantee. Randy was up against an opponent who had taken money from 53 of the same corporations that donated to Republican incumbent David Valadao , including Chevron, ExxonMobil, and Phillips 66. That same opponent accepted more than $54,000 from oil and gas interests in just one legislative session while representing communities breathing some of the dirtiest air in America. And on top of all that, the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC), the campaign arm for House Democrats, backed Randy’s corporate-backed opponent , bringing even more institutional support and outside spending into the race before voters ever cast their ballots. So take it from someone who’s gone up against the status quo for most of her life: this win wasn’t guaranteed. Randy stood strong in his values, refused to take a dime of corporate PAC money, and mobilized voters across his district, proving that people-powered campaigns can still win. I am honored to support his campaign, but our work is just beginning. name: Peggy Flanagan
subject: My opponent is trying to rewrite her record
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Hey Peter, I
know you’re getting a lot of emails, but I need you to see this:

A mysterious, dark money group is running a new ad trying to rewrite my
opponent’s record on ICE.

Minnesotans deserve to hear the truth from their elected leaders. Not lies
from a shady, undisclosed, dark money group.

Peter, I’ve always
stood with the immigrant community, and I always will.

And I won’t sit idly by as corporate interests try to change the story and
hide my opponent’s record. Minnesotans deserve better than that -- they
deserve the truth.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-peggy-em-20260610.nuvdgh&refcode=em20260610-6331&amount=3&t=1001&akid=6331%2E420207%2EgX9r4P ]Will you split a contribution today between my campaign and Pramila
Jayapal today to help us set the record straight? I’m the only candidate
in this race who will stand up to Donald Trump and ICE, no matter what the
dark money ads say.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-peggy-em-20260610.nuvdgh&amount=3&refcode=em20260610-6331&t=1002&akid=6331%2E420207%2EgX9r4P ]Contribute $3

Too many Minnesotans have already felt the chaos of Trump’s attacks and
ICE’s cruelty. My opponent is suddenly trying to act like something she’s
not, and that matters.

Here’s the truth about her record:

Just last year, she voted to strip immigrants of due process. While ICE
was kidnapping folks in American cities, she voted to praise them.

Now she's scrambling to hide her record, pretending she didn't legitimize
and praise Trump's mass deportation agenda.

This moment calls for leaders who will stand up to Trump and his chaos,
not back it. This moment calls for leaders who tell the truth, no matter
what.

Here’s my simple truth: I have spent my career fighting for working
families and standing shoulder-to-shoulder with the immigrant community.

I’ve been clear and consistent in my stance from the beginning because
voters deserve someone who won’t rewrite their history or flip-flop when
it matters most.

Minnesotans deserve a Senator who will rip ICE apart and secure justice
and accountability for all that we’ve lost.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-peggy-em-20260610.nuvdgh&refcode=em20260610-6331&amount=3&t=1003&akid=6331%2E420207%2EgX9r4P ]Will you split a donation between Pramila Jayapal and me to help us
respond? With the Trump administration and ICE continuing to come after
Minnesotans, we need a leader who will fight back with everything they’ve
got.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-peggy-em-20260610.nuvdgh&amount=3&refcode=em20260610-6331&t=1022&akid=6331%2E420207%2EgX9r4P ]Contribute $3

Thanks,

Peggy

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:

Peter, it's Sherrod Brown, writing to you with some news.

The first public poll of the general election in Ohio was just released, and you need to take a look:
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/13906?t=6&akid=1720%2E124072%2EZ-A1Hc)
This is a big deal. It’s the first public poll of the general election – and the data proves Ohio is ready to unseat my opponent, Jon Husted, and pave a path for us to flip the Senate in November.
**The momentum behind our campaign is growing, but so is the target on our backs. Republicans can see we’re putting up a fight, and they’re going to do whatever it takes to stop us in our tracks.[Before I say more, can you split any amount between my campaign and Roy Cooper's so we can hit our $100K rapid response goal and take on whatever’s next?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14209?amount=5&t=7&akid=1720%2E124072%2EZ-A1Hc)**

So they’re showing up to make a change and proving that we have the support to flip this seat, even in a state Trump won by 11 points last time.
Seriously, we’re 8 points ahead of our opponent in this latest poll. _That’s the good news._
Here’s the tough part: Outside Republican groups and corporations see these polls, too. **They’ve already publicly announced I’m one of their top targets and are spending $83 million against me, so another poll like this will give them all the more reason to dump a fortune into Ohio to take me down.**
I don’t know what’s coming next, but I know the _only_ way we can keep this going in our favor is by fighting hard each and every day until the election. Ohio broke the record for the most expensive Senate race in history last time, so we need a lot of support if we’re going to pull this off.

clean_body: Peter, I'm not emailing you today as just a Republican, because this is about more than politics. It's about what's right. I 'm emailing you today as a son who wants to clear his father's name. As you know, my father was wrongly impeached TWICE by radical congressional Democrats simply for standing up to the Swamp and fighting for the American people! Those impeachment hoaxes may have failed, but they're still recorded in the official congressional record. To make matters even worse, the Democrats have vowed to impeach my father if (God forbid) they take the House majority in the midterms this fall. But there's an easy way that our majorities can both clear my father's name AND get ahead of any future Democrat plots to impeach him... This bill would permanently ERASE both of the Democrats ' unjust impeachments from the congressional record, show that the GOP will no longer tolerate baseless impeachments, and most importantly, formally clear my father's name and completely vindicate him for future generations of historians. Trust me, there's nothing that would mean more to my father than complete and total vindication as we celebrate America's 250th birthday this summer! But to get this bill through Congress, we're going to need a massive groundswell of grassroots support from America First patriots like YOU. That's why I'm asking for your help reaching our ambitious signature goal. I hope I 'll see your name alongside my own! Thank you, Donald Trump Jr. | Paid for by the NRSC. body:
Let’s make big tech companies pay their fair share. | | | Peter, I’m Working Families Party-endorsed State Representative Elizabeth Fiedler, representing District 184 in South Philadelphia. I’m one of the lead sponsors of a bill in the **Tax Billionaires Fund PA plan** that would tax big tech corporations that exploit personal data to clutter our screens with ad after ad after ad. **I’m proud that yesterday, the Digital Ad Tax passed the Pennsylvania House and advanced to the Senate.** [**If you believe that we need to take on big tech and pass the Digital Ad Tax, tell your state Senator to pass the bill in the Senate now:**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39flXHMmeMQ4GTaibnjUGBRYuz_5CnzUpwM9jlG7H2Jx5S6n1rMvP5pGEA8CTqCKKSu6ahXnSXEI_RYVW9BKDbD9vGw7oTxnSVSPokDrcTBB9dYSmM8kycPKObGaxn7Q1SSrhS49sa8wfrPkpSwAAiB1KlDsweBXRkBMDy7lnRzKS_-7o8ZdJQ1bdT8unCvQFHMXciCjHSP-Rrandgrj8HMZd6vfL_m0KDTe7N_JZtP7WAHEDPg0g-jrixsG-vDIQcBR7Bung4CAbzrLVTzvwPmwGZ-bMx03W8xrUTXepOk01gMzKJFJLrEPLApxF_HmBIXR8W2v9PbDSZYytpIWQTy/4rd/WGHmT-CWQZ2c8kRWgHH3yg/h0/h001.8DZ0wvMUQVGgoBt8sa91CFNHs47B5EDMUD9AmBphneQ) **[Send a letter »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39flXHMmeMQ4GTaibnjUGBRYuz_5CnzUpwM9jlG7H2Jx5S6n1rMvP5pGEA8CTqCKKSu6ahXnSXEI_RYVW9BKDbD9vGw7oTxnSVSPokDrcTBB9dYSmM8kycPKObGaxn7Q1SSrhS49sa8wfrPkpSwAAiB55rlQMwCvkNBMtZMGR_gX8y_nNZr-7A2I64ykJnB3K0Mnfoz0Mv_sGEDi19FgqifpoVhjL6q8IOFEJnUORotcE3IzFqMNxRItMEIxPtUgFdvLokOKXIH6rFm6MinL6ztsRRf8gBkDb2vFYaXyzR7qdHlzg_-IUl-zalJ1YCaTDxYwBPPsTehnyTQYVcgPlXl/4rd/WGHmT-CWQZ2c8kRWgHH3yg/h1/h001.eTrRRC37e7WhNZyua8wu8GGWm8rQd4xKSwm64QDpeBs)** We are heading into a perfect storm: working people across Pennsylvania are facing rising bills at the same time that federal cuts to important programs are yanking out the rug from under them. I believe it is our obligation as state lawmakers to meet this moment. In Harrisburg, we hear all the time that the things we need aren’t possible. But we know the money we need exists; it’s just being hoarded by the wealthy few. We knew that we needed to get creative about raising revenue to relieve the burden on working people and to fund crucial public services. That’s why I worked with my colleagues in the House to propose the Digital Ad Tax. **Unlike every other type of advertiser, big tech companies aren’t paying taxes to show us digital ads.** This bill is about taxing that enormous profit and ensuring that billionaires and huge corporations like Google and Meta pay their fair share. In 2025, Meta made $196 billion in ad revenue alone. Yet these companies can only make this profit because of us. They harvest OUR private data — geolocation, searches, clicks, personal networks — to target us with the ads we see. But not a penny of that can be taxed in Pennsylvania under our current tax code. **It’s time to change that.** The digital ads industry alone is so profitable that just a 5% tax — which is what my bill proposes — could bring in more than $500 million dollars to our state every year. **And yesterday, we took a huge step forward to making the digital ads tax a reality.** This victory was made possible by the many elected officials who supported the legislation and the Tax Billionaires Fund PA coalition that advocated alongside community members and organized labor tirelessly to get it across the finish line in the House and now we need to make sure it passes in the Senate. body:
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260610-1.xKTdgJ&refcode=em20260610-1481&%3Bamount=5&t=1&akid=1481%2E1086043%2E3z-RP7)
Hey, it’s Rob Sand with some great news:
**I’m officially the Democratic nominee for Governor of Iowa.**
The other big development? **I’ll face Republican Zach Lahn in the general election.**
If you’re thinking, _“Who?”_ allow me to enlighten you.
Zach Lahn presents himself as some kind of outsider despite being aligned with (or even MORE extreme than) Kim Reynolds in basically every way that counts. Yet he’s trying to convince us that the solution to ten years of failed one-party rule is... _four more years of one-party rule._
Clearly, there’s an extraordinary amount at stake in this election, and it’s really, really important that we come out on top in November, so I’ll pop the question:
**[Will you become one of the very first supporters of the general election by splitting a donation between my campaign and Wes Moore today? Your contribution will lay the groundwork for everything we do in the next five months and everything we achieve in the next four years.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260610-1.xKTdgJ&refcode=em-20260610-1&t=2&akid=1481%2E1086043%2E3z-RP7)**

We’re in the grips of a generational farm crisis, mass layoffs, education cuts, rising cancer rates, rural hospital closures, brain drain, and **an economy that is now the worst in the country.**
These are real problems that affect real people. Meanwhile, Zach Lahn is palling around with Steve King and fighting radicalism in fifth-grade math textbooks. 🙄

I believe Iowans will see the contrast, but winning requires us to be realistic about the challenges we’re facing. _This race is wide open. The political winds are unpredictable. I don’t take any corporate PAC money._

Rob Sand

# Powell to the People
---
| | | |
---
|
## Campaign Update
League of Conservation Voters Endorse Nate Powell!
* The League of Conservation Voters (LCV) Action Fund announced its endorsement of Independent candidate Nate Powell for U.S. Congress.
* The LCV Action Fund works to elect candidates who support affordable energy and responsible stewardship of natural resources. Since 1990, the organization has helped elect and re-elect more than 100 U.S. Senators and more than 500 members of the U.S. House of Representatives. The endorsement places Powell alongside a select group of candidates endorsed by the organization nationwide.

---
| | | |
* "The endorsement of the League of Conservation Voters Action Fund is especially meaningful in a district where Michael Baumgartner has made fast-tracking Big Tech data centers at the expense of common sense protections a legislative priority," said Powell.
* "Our families should not be forced to pay higher electric bills. Our farmers should not have to compete with data centers for access to water. And no community in this district should be threatened with polluted groundwater while residents in the West Plains area are still facing contamination from PFAS. We can embrace new technology without sacrificing the communities that already live here."

---
| | | |
---

It’s Byron Donalds, President Trump’s STRONGEST ally in Florida.

But the General Election is a whole different animal.
Anti-Trump RINOs will team up with the Trump-hating Democrats to flood Florida with seven-figure ad buys, polls will tighten, and the national spotlight will become blinding.
In 2025, Democrats raised $1.8 Billion via ActBlue, and there’s no question that they’ll top that this year!
That’s why I can’t take these threats lightly.
Because when left-wing Democrats flip a Republican-held Governor’s seat, it doesn’t just impact one state.
It steers the national conversation against President Trump and all of MAGA.
Lose just one race you’re supposed to win, and suddenly the Fake News starts jawing about MAGA being on its last legs.
And the Democrats know how to keep the narrative alive for as long as humanly possible.
With you by my side, we won’t be intimidated or let it get to that point.

The truth is, they know they can’t win in a fair fight.
That’s why they’ve called upon their liberal media allies to launch MASSIVE smear campaigns against me, my family, and my closest friends.
All just to distract people from their so far left agenda that failed America when Joe Biden was President.
And as America’s freest state, Florida needs to continue to be a vanguard for the other 49 states to follow.
We have an uphill battle ahead, but I know you’re up for the challenge.
With you by my side, we will deliver ANOTHER victory for MAGA.

Hi there,
The way we teach history shapes how the next generation sees America—and right now, that story is changing.
This past Wednesday, I took a closer look at how American history is presented in classrooms today. And what I found was striking. According to a Northwestern University Institute for Policy Research survey, 73% of Americans are dissatisfied with the way the subject is taught in public schools.
That stat tells you everything—parents across the political spectrum recognize that something is wrong.
As you know, these new curricula emphasize systemic challenges and injustices. **Students graduate without understanding the full story—the courage, sacrifice, and vision that built this nation. That's one reason the work of the Moving Picture Institute (MPI) matters so much to me. At MPI, we make movies that highlight the ideals of freedom, character, and service, and help bring these important stories to life for new audiences.**
And this matters more now than ever before. A generation is growing up without access to the stories and films that you and I had. We grew up with movies like _D-Day_ , _Davy Crocket_ , _The Alamo_ , _Top Gun_ —heck, just 20 years ago they made _The Patriot_.
But MPI is counteracting that by making a movie for families with children.
**Son of 1776** is an animated film where a young patriot joins George Washington and experiences the American Revolution. Children and families will see the bravery and sacrifice that forged this great nation. This is a movie that WILL celebrate America's 250th birthday.

clean_body: Hollywood's Missed Opportunity Son of 1776 needs your support to reach millions of young Americans with the true story of America's founding. Hi there, The way we teach history shapes how the next generation sees America—and right now, that story is changing. This past Wednesday, I took a closer look at how American history is presented in classrooms today. And what I found was striking. According to a Northwestern University Institute for Policy Research survey, 73% of Americans are dissatisfied with the way the subject is taught in public schools. That stat tells you everything—parents across the political spectrum recognize that something is wrong. As you know, these new curricula emphasize systemic challenges and injustices. Students graduate without understanding the full story—the courage, sacrifice, and vision that built this nation. That's one reason the work of the Moving Picture Institute (MPI) matters so much to me. At MPI, we make movies that highlight the ideals of freedom, character, and service, and help bring these important stories to life for new audiences. And this matters more now than ever before. A generation is growing up without access to the stories and films that you and I had. We grew up with movies like D-Day , Davy Crocket , The Alamo , Top Gun —heck, just 20 years ago they made The Patriot. But MPI is counteracting that by making a movie for families with children. Son of 1776 is an animated film where a young patriot joins George Washington and experiences the American Revolution. Children and families will see the bravery and sacrifice that forged this great nation. This is a movie that WILL celebrate America's 250th birthday. | | ---|---|--- | | Sincerely, Joseph Corey Vice President of Philanthropic Investments The Moving Picture Institute | 375 Greenwich Street New York NY 10013

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | We printed 1,000 copies of this report. 688 are gone. | | | | Peter, President Trump’s birthday is coming up — and _**Vice-President JD Vance**_ is putting together a special birthday card from his strongest supporters across the country. # [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240895%2E444211%2EKR-iqC)
I hired Aimee Prudhomme last year to run Powered by People because I knew that for us to make the biggest possible difference in the 2026 elections we needed the strongest leader we could find.
I got to know Aimee back in 2024 because she was one of the most exciting volunteers we had in Houston, maybe in the state. She created registration events at local universities, recruited and led other volunteers, and helped build a strong community around the work we were doing.
It’s one of the reasons that the Houston area consistently posted some of our strongest numbers on registrations, voter engagement and — most importantly — turnout.
Though she had a demanding day job and a career to which she’d devoted more than a decade of her life, she was committed to Powered by People, our organizing philosophy and our team.
When the position became available last fall, I began to talk with Aimee about joining us as our leader. The fact that she was a political outsider — not having run campaigns or become embedded in party politics — I saw as an asset. We need to find new ways to reach new voters, and that becomes possible with new perspectives.
Plus, she understood PXP as well as anyone — she believed in the organizing model, believed in taking chances, believed in person-to-person connections over those forged by money and tech.
In the nearly 6 months that she’s been at the helm, Aimee has begun to transform our organization, bringing a new level of professionalism, higher accountability, and greater focus on the volunteer experience. She’s also initiated new programs that supplement our core campus organizing effort.
And she’s laser focused on the thing that matters most: winning.
She has set an ambitious and achievable target of 100,000 new voters in our relational network — 100,000 Texans who might not otherwise vote but for the personal engagement of our PXP volunteers.
We’re all rallying around her to get it done and to win political power for Democrats in Texas. James Talarico. Gina Hinojosa. Democrats running at every place on the ballot.
[**I’m grateful Aimee said yes when I asked her to step up. We’re lucky to have her leading this extraordinary effort. Please show your support for Aimee and Powered by People by making a contribution today.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260610.jqQa4H&refcode=ema20260610-240895&t=3&akid=240895%2E444211%2EKR-iqC)

Thank you,
Beto

Hey folks,
I've been frustrated for a while watching one of the strongest Democratic voices in the country get far less attention than she deserves. So I was glad to sit down with **Minnesota Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan** , who's running for U.S. Senate and building something that feels increasingly rare in politics: a people-powered campaign that's actually connecting with voters.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:44**] Peggy breaks down the state of the Senate race, the overwhelming support behind her campaign, and why she believes Minnesota is at the center of the Democratic Party's future.
* [**00:04:01**] We dive into the growing threat of AI deepfakes in politics, the fight to protect democracy, and why media literacy is becoming an essential skill for the next generation.
* [**00:08:14**] A conversation about Paul Wellstone's legacy, what politics should actually be about, and why so many Americans feel abandoned by institutions that are supposed to serve them.
* [**00:12:26**] Peggy shares a powerful story from rural Minnesota about winning over skeptical Trump voters simply by showing up, listening, and having honest conversations.
* [**00:15:31**] We close with a candid discussion about economic frustration, political realignment, and why grassroots organizing remains the best antidote to corporate influence and cynicism.

This conversation is about more than one Senate race. It's about what happens when candidates focus on people instead of consultants, communities instead of corporations, and solutions instead of spectacle. If you've been wondering how Democrats reconnect with working people, rural voters, and the folks who feel left behind by politics, this is an essential watch.
And if you value honest conversations like this, help me keep them going.

With urgency,
--Mike

body:
Join us on July 14 for a candid conversation with myself, Jane Fonda, and special guests about the future of the Democratic Party.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260610-2&t=1&akid=3584%2E587540%2EzS3JiH)
**Jane Fonda and I are teaming up, Peter — and I couldn’t be more excited about it.**
Our entire mission at Leaders We Deserve is to build a Democratic Party worth believing in. One led by a new generation of bold, audacious leaders who are determined to fight for a future where _everyone_ can thrive.
Jane has been fighting for that same future for decades.
She created her own Climate PAC to confront the climate crisis and elect leaders who will protect this planet for generations to come. She shows up, and refuses to accept the world as it is when she knows it can be better — just like Leaders We Deserve.
So when the opportunity for Jane and I to team up came around, it was a no-brainer.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=jfcp-lwd-the-fight-for-our-future-split.xCoWLI&refcode=lwd-email-20260610-3584&t=2&akid=3584%2E587540%2EzS3JiH)
I’d love if you could join us on **Tuesday, July 14 at 4:30PM PT/ 7:30PM ET** for an exclusive conversation between myself, Jane Fonda, and special guests about the state of our democracy, the leaders we need to save it, and why neither of us will stop fighting for it.
Tickets start at $30, and all proceeds will go towards supporting Jane’s Climate PAC and Leaders We Deserve in our shared mission of electing the next generation of courageous young leaders who will fight for the future we deserve.
**[Get your tickets below — you won’t want to miss this one.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=jfcp-lwd-the-fight-for-our-future-split.xCoWLI&refcode=lwd-email-20260610-3584&t=3&akid=3584%2E587540%2EzS3JiH)**

Thank you,
David Hogg
Co-Founder, Leaders We Deserve

Let that sink in. More than half the country is skipping items they need, stretching every dollar, and changing plans just to get through a trip to the store.

And this administration's response? More tax cuts for billionaires. More tariffs driving up the cost of everyday goods. More chaos that working families are left to absorb.

I co-founded the Lowering Costs Caucus because I believe government should be fighting to make life more affordable, not harder. I've pushed to lower prescription drug prices, demanded action on skyrocketing energy costs, and fought every day to make sure West Michigan families have a voice in Washington.

But I'll be honest with you: if we want to stand up to the dark-money forces coming out of Washington, I need the resources to keep fighting.

Our FEC deadline is June 30th. Those numbers go public and everyone will be watching. Donors, analysts, and yes, the DeVos machine that is already spending to take this seat back. Strong grassroots numbers send a clear message that MI-03 is defended.

subject: We need to talk Data Centers....
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION * 6709 West 119th Street * Ste
body:
Over the past several weeks, I've heard from many Johnson County residents who are concerned about the rapid push for data center development.........

| | | | | |
---
| |

Friends,Over the past several weeks, I've heard from many Johnson County residents who are concerned about the rapid push for data center development in our community.Questions have been raised about energy consumption, water usage, infrastructure demands, tax incentives, environmental impacts, and the potential effects on neighboring property owners. Others have asked whether the promised economic benefits will outweigh the long-term costs. Some are concerned that massive data centers will be built, technology will catch up, and communities will be left with huge empty buildings.ALL of these concerns are valid, and elected officials need to listen.Look at what has happened in DeSoto.
* City Council approved the Beale project in August 2025 for 1.14 million square feet.
* Current reporting is that they intend to build out over 2.9 million square feet.
* An increase of 156%
* City Council says there is nothing they can do to prevent this

Why didn’t the City do a better job of defining the parameters and expectations of this project?The citizens of DeSoto and Johnson County deserve better.**That's why I support a** _**minimum**_**two-year moratorium on new data center approvals while an independent study is conducted to fully evaluate the impacts and identify potential solutions and safeguards.** This is not about being anti-growth or anti-business. This is about ensuring we protect our citizens.As a small business owner, I understand the importance of economic development. But growth should be thoughtful, transparent, and based on facts. When decisions have the potential to affect our community for decades, we owe it to residents to do our homework first.Too often, the government moves forward before citizens have all the information. We should reverse that process.
* Let's gather the facts
* Let's hear from**independent** experts
* Let's have an open and transparent public discussion
* And then let's make decisions that are in the best interest of Johnson County residents.

As your next Johnson County Commission Chair, I will always believe that taxpayers and residents deserve a seat at the table before decisions are made, not after.Here are ways you can help restore transparency and common sense to our local government:

name: The Antimonopolist
subject: The Rollercoaster
body:
Eleven years ago, I received an irresistible inviation. Would I be interested in riding a rollercoaster at Six Flags with Steven Colbert and talk to him about the Constitution? It was fun, he sent me a nice note and a bucket of ice cream, and that was that. It never aired, and I assumed it never would. We hadn't gotten kind of technical on Marbury v. Madison, after all, not what I think he was hoping for. Until two weeks ago, in his final weekend, Colbert ran "The Worst of the Late Show," clips

Some thoughts on the SCOTUS problem from 2015
| | | Eleven years ago, I received an irresistible inviation. Would I be interested in riding a rollercoaster at Six Flags with Steven Colbert and talk to him about the Constitution? It was fun, he sent me a nice note and a bucket of ice cream, and that was that. It never aired, and I assumed it never would. We hadn't gotten kind of technical on Marbury v. Madison, after all, not what I think he was hoping for. Until two weeks ago, in his final weekend, Colbert ran "The Worst of the Late Show," clips so bad they belonged in a bloopers real. I stand by what I said: | | | [The Worst of Colbert ](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/b7f2ce38?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)
---
[The Worst of Colbert .mov • 64 MB](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/fe725b45?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)
---
[ ](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/0f972aff?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)
The Supreme Court really did undermine the Constitution in those cases, and also local, democratic decisionmaking. But I'm more hopeful than I was in 2015 that we could get a constitutional amendment- there's so much more bipartisan anger about money in politics.
Speaking of rollercoasters, lets talk about the state level bills to ban surveillance wages and prices, a project I've been working on for the last two years. I think of it like fracking--its easier to ban it before it becomes too entrenched--and several states have now proposed laws, many of which I worked on. The issue is incredibly popular: people do not think its right for a retailer, or employer, to use data like your credit score or your romantic situation or your mood to set prices or compensation.
In Maryland, they passed a terrible law, worse than nothing, that said it bans surveillance prices but doesn't ban price differences based on data actually makes it harder to bring a lawsuit under existing law. Complicated but bad. In Colorado, both houses passed an incredibly strong law against both surveillance wages and prices, but Jared Polis vetoed it. Uncomplicatedly bad. In New York, a good bill, weakened by industry but still real progress, has passed both the Assembly and Senate. Its all on Hochul. She's over-active with the veto pen, but I'm hopeful that people hate surveillance so much that she'll sign it.
So, speaking of that Colorado bill, there's just a few weeks left before the Colorado primary for Attorney General.
My good friend [_David Seligman_](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/1f34502b?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21), candidate for Attorney General in Colorado, had stepped away from the campaign trail for a few days to be with his family after the tragic loss of his father. I wanted to ask for your your help to step up for him in this moment.
[**_DONATE NOW_**](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/a1e6a36f?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)
We need state AGs that are imaginative, serious, and driven by a desire for fairness to stop rampant white collar illegality.
Seligman has stood up in court on behalf of working people-building the bold, imaginative legal theories to take on the largest corporate landlord in America for [_illegally overcharging tenants_](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/34237d57?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21), the meatpacker [_JBS for systematically injuring workers_](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/ee3fcb76?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)on the line and treating them as disposable, [_Uber and Lyft_](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/43e670d2?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)for using algorithms to control their drivers while also cheating them out of pay.
Every day David was off the trail was a day his campaign isn't raising money during a critical point of this competitive primary. That gap needs to be filled immediately.
[**_Please give what you can today and share this with someone who believes in electing the people 's lawyer._**](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/2eea8dbb?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)
He was just endorsed by the Working Families Party, and brings a kind of constantly ranging, serious mind focused on solving problems, both the problems of abusive bosses and the problems of abusive, lawbreaking, Presidents.
The last candidate I wrote you about, Chris Rabb, won an incredible victory last month, beating the establishment in Philadelphia. He's a sure thing to win the general, so keep watching for Rep Rabb.
I've been busy finishing up a book called "Anti-monopoly: A Citizens Guide", and it won't come out until January, but you can pre-order here. ([https://thenewpress.org/books/anti-monopoly/](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/96bae148?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)). The description is a little dated (the examples I use in the book are slightly different, but you get the idea. If you have a bookstore that would be interested in holding a book reading, or an active group that would be interested, there is almost nothing more that I like than talking to people about democracy and power, and I'll come anywhere--let me know!
I've been thinking a lot about how we can join the anticorruption and antimonopoly movements together--they really are the same fight.
More soon,
Zephyr

Peter — Trump and
MAGA extremists will do anything in their power to silence the Squad.

They’ve made it crystal clear: attack them, threaten them, demonize them,
and drain them. Do whatever it takes to stop Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan,
and Rashida from speaking truth to power.

It’s not working.

The Squad has never stayed quiet in the face of injustice. Not when Trump
unleashed ICE into our streets and came for immigrants. Not when this
administration targets LGBTQ+ communities. Not when extremists try to drag
this country backward and undo decades of progress.

Our progressive champions have fought back every single time, and they're
not stopping now. But these attacks are escalating, and they come with a
real cost.

don't just put the Squad at risk — they put their families, staff, and
communities in danger too. And right now, the Squad is being forced to
spend enormous resources on security just to safely show up and do their
jobs.

That's money that should be going toward organizing at the grassroots
level, mobilizing our communities, and fighting for working people.

This is exactly what Trump is counting on. If he makes the attacks vicious
enough, the Squad gets buried under the weight of just staying safe — and
they won't have the resources to fight back.

We refuse to let that happen. With this grassroots movement behind them,
we can make sure the Squad stays safe, stays in office, and keeps fighting
for the people who need them most.

Now, he's taking that work to the next level by serving as your Congressman, representing New York's 16th District. If you’d like to unsubscribe, click here. # [#]
Hi there, it’s George Latimer.

With less than a month away from America’s 250th anniversary, it’s a great time to remind ourselves of the values our country was built on: liberty, equality, and democracy.

Donald Trump has embodied the complete opposite.

Trump has been:

* Undermining our elections and working to silence as many voices as he can to try to guarantee the midterms.
* Repeatedly giving handouts to his billionaire megadonors and making it harder for everyday Americans just to get by.

And not only that, under Trump, our cost of living is only rising, seniors are worried about whether their Social Security will be there when they need it, and Americans just want an equal shot, not a system that just rewards the elites.

America was founded for liberty and equality for all – not just the select few.

As your representative, the most important part of my job is listening to folks from all corners of NY-16, and I want to hear from you. Will you take our Trump Approval Poll and share your thoughts on Donald Trump’s time in office so far? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/uRVZTUabBEK_pQhEt4vKag2]

TAKE THE POLL [https://secure.ngpvan.com/uRVZTUabBEK_pQhEt4vKag2]

Thank you for your input,

George Latimer

George’s unparalleled track record in advancing Democratic goals includes successfully cutting regressive taxes, fighting for civil rights and racial equality, defending a woman’s right to choose, standing up to the NRA to keep guns off our streets, and voting for marriage equality.

Happy Pride, friend! Last weekend, I got to join Motor City Pride, and I was so filled with joy to hear my neighbors thanking my team and me for fighting for them. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTNKDNKKsCx8ITAbXrP8b3lMoMib4wfB9PbcEIUqO1HauzTm-nXXBvFQDzYvHf0p_6xJld6qvxWI62rCcbEjHekpG_p7nbHss81KYNCeKPvKYh9U4Gaj3irAiwZElag-ID-Mk4I8n-iJqi1oMLurIeZC8WRjh_yt-KqGTLclJB86C1Lpr4ix1MWy5gyv3Nhdtn8ZFTVpVuzhZnFgvqexY4uIA_3PfDYw0orECX73A4UmVswxu3Ji7sUQycdk4UCZPb89KaLA4VFPQLz916-E4aDmvmxUJitQxkvfuQPA0_HAB2orVrOHgKR9RJfJ2EMHUnw/4rd/ukAyhmBJTM2Pb01gv1qK9A/h1/h001.tnXG7SFeSQRrfQv3542wBcBkAE9A9A75-01ApO3-k7A) LGBTQI+ people, I’ve got your back. I’ll always fight in Congress to protect your rights, your safety, and your ability to live freely and authentically. That includes speaking out against transphobia, holding and participating in hearings about issues facing the LGBTQI+ community, being part of the Equality Caucus, and securing federal funding for groups in my district that support LGBTQI+ people. I’m also cosponsoring policies like the **_Transgender Health Care Access Act_** ,**__** the **_Trans Bill of Rights_** , the **_Pride in Mental Health Act_** _,_ and the **_Equality Act_**. And my **_Justice For All Act_** would expand civil rights laws, including making sure that people are protected from intentional _and_ unintentional discrimination that’s based on their gender identity or sexual orientation. Passing these changes into law would override many of Trump’s and state leaders’ dangerous attacks on our trans siblings. [**Could you take action in support of trans and queer people this Pride, starting with signing onto our petition demanding Members of Congress support pro-LGBTQI+ policies?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTNKDNKKsCx8ITAbXrP8b3lMoMib4wfB9PbcEIUqO1HauzTm-nXXBvFQDzYvHf0p_6xJld6qvxWI62rCcbEjHekpG_p7nbHss81KYNCeKPvKYh9U4Gaj3irAiwZElag-ID22F6aKxX7dU1bBiW1CEwFUj4rehqqi2nixY5shqOWu75NI96oA-DfMLZl4grblJyrwNOMcdgtePkAU5D_noRe3M39i_6lLhfUK7Ds62CHBZCAIQXsXxCwinnVEMIzgr0LY-eby_xpo2qr8oMTN-0KTSAQMp31crxhxeGroz5vcjkMdAHi1rghDyZXBQkZOnGw/4rd/ukAyhmBJTM2Pb01gv1qK9A/h2/h001.0lZlWpO0hV7BGflS0Q6QCiN36nySz2TrPAdbZVJ2pLs) [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTNKDNKKsCx8ITAbXrP8b3lMoMib4wfB9PbcEIUqO1HauzTm-nXXBvFQDzYvHf0p_6xJld6qvxWI62rCcbEjHekpG_p7nbHss81KYNCeKPvKYh9U4Gaj3irAiwZElag-ID2_tvno2rkOJVcnDajwhiH-MZsbatSIg1BltIVnDfnCis1ximd_c25A6tdB2Tuyfvm-2ReLfemaUp3ae5XYeImaZO8sU-vZxlUeo0IlJLZjOKcbsAxmB5j5TUaH5iCm7oFJa-O3MPP0qxOUCt2s-PWFffwS60EUhthb06B4vOKvgwem9ylAQgsUlC66MYrYZ4Q/4rd/ukAyhmBJTM2Pb01gv1qK9A/h3/h001.TdnxcbuDoDX8vr_b3AO_hV9EcZmt0W_x2WUb8LJyNUs) | [SIGN ON](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTNKDNKKsCx8ITAbXrP8b3lMoMib4wfB9PbcEIUqO1HauzTm-nXXBvFQDzYvHf0p_6xJld6qvxWI62rCcbEjHekpG_p7nbHss81KYNCeKPvKYh9U4Gaj3irAiwZElag-ID2ee8qWp3kWtpYMu71EfcaCaqEGoEoQGqHvv8zRS4-fJQUJUrWnUtpv-Hu6Yk2hyvR0XAva0CSc0MhOCaok3UczTQHYaUo-NdmBJjaH8t16sos0jXJo1NFGIuhCjO7akGJRPujPIJXndMAxNZb24zlGHtqga-C1llQdMDefsS47Tep4LUmlCDhaEwq1ulHPCdA/4rd/ukAyhmBJTM2Pb01gv1qK9A/h4/h001.DRdf9W6pI83P1eVrxvveYbxTyLEeVZGndxPIlZl7JDA)

As we celebrate Pride, we also mourn and remember beloved Black trans women in and near Detroit whose lives were tragically cut short in recent years due to violence:
Tahiry Broom (29), Karmin Wells (25), Christina Hayes (38), Ashia Davis (34), Naomie Skinner (25), Dede Ricks (33), Hayden Davis (28), and Natasha Keianna (37)
Black trans women led protests across the country in the 1950s and 1960s, up through the 1969 Stonewall uprising, which inspired the first Pride march. In very hostile times, Black trans women have fought for and won progress that has benefited us all. The rest of us need to be an ally and fight for them.
The Lemkin Institute for Genocide Prevention has warned that our country is in the middle of a genocide against transgender people, especially with the Trump administration’s escalating attacks against trans people’s very existence.
**We must all get louder in the fight for trans people’s rights and lives.**
**[Please take a moment to demand Congress support policies to expand protections for—rather than endanger—the LGBTQI+ community.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTNKDNKKsCx8ITAbXrP8b3lMoMib4wfB9PbcEIUqO1HauzTm-nXXBvFQDzYvHf0p_6xJld6qvxWI62rCcbEjHekpG_p7nbHss81KYNCeKPvKYh9U4Gaj3irAiwZElag-ID-PBLhRR2IE20MGXRMnTln--J0-vTmm64qXEhZfDe0UZyWoeGNcruWsCUYWqpiPdN7MVx_H50MEOccmpK5hJXXIeUF2lJv8rXATzqptBne1t-pOKw1xleeo9OZA7K-mVPwqGgombvJ8LsFZ7Ruz-CTShgjA4fkJRwApnk7Uvy86QrT6RymBYZhMVnYNEbvjuoA/4rd/ukAyhmBJTM2Pb01gv1qK9A/h5/h001.FtWW0AMlJ7yc5OAjnV6KdhgxRwvorUe-wra5sPzvCkA)**

Together, let’s continue to demand dignity and safety for Black trans women, as well as all trans, intersex, gender nonconforming, and queer people.
In solidarity,
Rashida

body:
Aaron just won the primary, and we want to make the case for why right now is the moment to chip in $3.
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=276%2E127862%2E1bbMgv)
Aaron just won the primary, and we want to make the case for why _right now_ is the moment to chip in $3. **Here are three reasons why your donation would make a huge impact today:**
1. **Cook Political Report rates this race a toss-up.** The most respected race-raters in the country say Nevada's governor's race is within our reach. That makes every contribution count in an even greater way.
2. **The polls show Aaron is statistically tied.** This is arguably Democrats’ best opportunity to flip a governor’s race blue this November. And in a race this close, every little bit of support makes a difference.
3. **We have the momentum. We just need the resources.** The energy on the ground following Aaron’s win is palpable, and we're heading into the general with everything it takes to win, except _one_ thing: the resources to match it. We’re counting on grassroots support to fill that gap.

subject: Hitting our summer stride ☀️
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
THIS THURSDAY: Data Centers Movie and Discussion in Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Data%20Center%20event.png]
You still have time to RSVP! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2] – Join TOP on Thursday, June 11 at 6 p.m. the historic Texas Theatre in Dallas for a FREE documentary screening and discussion with community members to learn about data centers and how they can impact our communities. From city to city across the country, these huge facilities are bringing with them higher water bills, increased pollution, and public health risks, while straining on our already unstable energy grid.
Reserve your FREE seat today, and bring a friend! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2]
📆 Thursday, June 11th at 6 p.m.
📍Texas Theatre (231 Jefferson Blvd.)
🏆 Attendees have a chance to win a $100 gift card
For more information, contact Jet at (469) 550-4750.
http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2 [http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2]
RIGHT2JUSTICE:
Help TOP end non-safety traffic stops and mass surveillance in Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Scales%20and%20gavel%20-%20R2J.png]
Texans want dignity, freedom, and privacy, but any given day traffic stops for minor, non‐safety issues pull people into unnecessary police contact with no real public‐safety benefit.
At the same time, Automated License Plate Readers like Flock Safety cameras are spreading across the state, creating massive databases that track where residents drive, work, worship, and seek care. These practices hit our Black, Latino, immigrant, and low‐income communities the hardest, trapping people in the legal system while raising concerns about privacy, civil liberties, racial profiling, and accountability.
Interested in pushing back against non-safety traffic stops and mass surveillance in Texas? If yes, then email Dr. Doshie Piper at dpiper@organizetexas.org [dpiper@organizetexas.org] to see how you can join in our Right2Justice campaign efforts!
ADD YOUR NAME:
Take the Willing to Fight Pledge
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
If we want to stop harmful actions on our democracy and communities, we need millions of people fighting back together in peaceful and impactful ways. That's why TOP is proud to team up with our friends at the Organizing Revival Network to share their Willing to Fight Pledge, as we look to unite Texans on a vision that moves ALL communities forward.
👉🏾 ACT NOW: Take the pledge today! [https://www.willingtofight.org/orn]
TOP Tip: Raise awareness about Men's Health Month
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Men%27s%20health%20heart.jpg]
June is Men's Health Month! One of the many ways to engage is to empower the men in your life – whether it be your father, husband, partner, brother, son, grandfather, coworker, or even friend – to take control of their health. Because men’s health isn’t just a man’s issue; it’s a family issue that affects everyone. One particular aspect of health that impacts men is mental health. Read and share these resources from the National Alliance on Mental Illness. [https://www.nami.org/stay-connected/events/awareness-events/mens-health-month/]
https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2 [https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2]
Español
ESTE JUEVES: Película sobre centros de datos y una conversación en Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Data%20Center%20event.png]
¡Todavía estás a tiempo de confirmar tu asistencia! [http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2] Acompaña a TOP el jueves 11 de junio a las 6 p. m. en el histórico Texas Theatre de Dallas para una proyección gratuita de un documental y una plática con miembros de la comunidad; aprenderás sobre los centros de datos y el impacto que pueden tener en nuestras comunidades. En ciudades de todo el país, estas enormes instalaciones traen consigo facturas de agua más altas, mayor contaminación y riesgos para la salud pública, además de sobrecargar nuestra red eléctrica, que ya de por sí es inestable.
¡Reserva tu lugar GRATIS hoy mismo y trae a una amistad! [http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2]
📆 Jueves 11 de junio a las 6 p.m.
📍 Texas Theatre (231 Jefferson Blvd.)
🏆 Los asistentes tendrán la oportunidad de ganar una tarjeta de regalo de $100.
Para más información, comunícate con Jet al (469) 550-4750.
http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2 [http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2]
RIGHT2JUSTICE:
Ayúdanos a poner fin a las paradas de tráfico no relacionadas con la seguridad y a la vigilancia masiva en Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Scales%20and%20gavel%20-%20R2J.png]
Los tejanos quieren dignidad, libertad y privacidad; sin embargo, a diario se realizan paradas de tráfico por infracciones menores ajenas a la seguridad vial que someten a las personas a interacciones policiales innecesarias, sin aportar ningún beneficio real a la seguridad pública.
Al mismo tiempo, los lectores automáticos de placas vehiculares, como las cámaras de Flock Safety, se están expandiendo por todo el estado, creando enormes bases de datos que rastrean dónde conducen, trabajan, practican su fe y reciben atención médica las personas. Estas prácticas afectan de manera desproporcionada a nuestras comunidades afrodescendientes, latinas, inmigrantes y de bajos ingresos, atrapando a las personas en el sistema legal mientras generan serias preocupaciones sobre la privacidad, las libertades civiles, la elaboración de perfiles raciales y la rendición de cuentas.
¿Le interesa oponerse a las paradas de tráfico no relacionadas con la seguridad y a la vigilancia masiva en Texas? Si es así, envíe un correo electrónico a la Dra. Doshie Piper a dpiper@organizetexas.org [dpiper@organizetexas.org] para saber cómo puede unirse a los esfuerzos de nuestra campaña Right2Justice.
AÑADE TU NOMBRE: Firma el Compromiso de Luchar
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
Si queremos detener las acciones perjudiciales contra nuestra democracia y nuestras comunidades, necesitamos que millones de personas se unan para responder de manera pacífica y efectiva. Por eso, TOP se enorgullece de colaborar con nuestros aliados de Organizing Revival Network para compartir su Compromiso de Estar Dispuestos a Luchar, mientras buscamos unir a los tejanos en torno a una visión que impulse el progreso de TODAS las comunidades.
👉🏾 ACTÚA AHORA: ¡Firma el compromiso hoy mismo! [http://www.willingtofight.org/orn]
Consejos de TOP: Crear conciencia sobre el Mes de la Salud de los Hombres
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Men%27s%20health%20heart.jpg]
¡Junio es el Mes de la Salud de los Hombres! Una de las muchas formas de participar es animar a los hombres de tu vida, ya sea tu padre, esposo, pareja, hermano, hijo, abuelo, compañero de trabajo o incluso un amigo, a tomar el control de su salud. Porque la salud de los hombres no es solo un asunto de hombres; es un tema familiar que nos afecta a todos. Un aspecto de la salud que repercute especialmente en los hombres es la salud mental. Consulta y comparte estos recursos de la Alianza Nacional sobre Enfermedades Mentales. [https://www.nami.org/stay-connected/events/awareness-events/mens-health-month/]
https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2 [https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2]

subject: Happy Pride Month 🏳️‍🌈
body:
Let’s piss some Republicans off.
---
Derek, Happy Pride Month from all of us at the DNC! [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-june-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20260610_7486_fr&amount=7&refcode2=7486_22930333_PGSA5M&akid=7486%2E22930333%2EPGSA5M) We know that this is a dark moment for our country — and that in dark moments, it can be hard to celebrate. But we want you to know: **We won't let MAGA Republicans stop us from fighting tooth and nail for the LGBTQ+ community, and we won’t let them stop us from celebrating loudly and proudly either.** This month is a time to celebrate the rich, diverse tapestry of people who make America great. That might piss some Republicans off, but _that’s okay._ Pride has always been a celebration of love and joy in the face of hate and fear. | | | | |
---
Hey Peter, Chaz just sat down with James Carville and Al Hunt on Politics War Room, and James had something to say at the end that we think you should hear. [**But first, can you chip in $5?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/H4fmIM0kjweA4lziokdwqw~~/AAUS1hA~/w-4KSzvwl6OXCPAl3gbYzLXyKti2biJvelaKa7VOMA8iNFgy0aLSOQ3Z-f_F4KVDgI5tRYyTdI_yzRQ0joz9g9zZd6lSqNF-w2SWpKOUuNgpX0TMcIjQIbZtEG3dDWqVfi6xXthKb5tX6t7iH9BL3B_y3Du3xkJnh4eNfsbUN4wkr1TArZWKjWjYVXpGLIyNobl7WRK61Ir8tU7VQXsTgd3vLKrzgP2Srx6b5yUFs98Qm7RW5YpCqrlZiNE1J1TPhQhw7Ps5lsQDIp5nsucXjw~~) | | [CHIP IN $5](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/u2daJfQ1GLyd9Q1YiCqaJg~~/AAUS1hA~/spDUfT0w-9SRLL3C_NuJ7HxyV15xgGghgB1_ni5BALfBz2E48UYJ8hLK0sZC7FF-w3Iwaa3kxjMIE55bR-1tGPmufcZDuECGEuKXKScSUDtTqiINtQYsAqTdI9ke-cnHxU_4P7eFYVCu2pKbpo_x9NDYs6KGUOVW3Du4k28TquJ_0kkA5Fn7yHIZ4Qs6niMigucnSUN5Fd5P5jpkdZMlZ5ZBZVnegzfJUsH1ydq9CDNvo_mf7bzNCVwz6kgVsHityKVdKvoAy6iwmy3nTeoZXg~~)
---
Here is what they talked about:
* **On Andy Ogles:** "He's an embarrassment of riches. People want a congressman they can believe in and trust, and Andy Ogles is not those two things."
* **On kitchen table issues:** "Potholes don't have partisan labels. As mayor, you solve problems and people want problem solvers."
* **On winning in Trump country:** "I beat the two-term incumbent Republican mayor 60% to 40% in a community Donald Trump won by 44 points."

Keisha Lance Bottoms

The general election is underway, and I'm proud to stand alongside my friend Xavier Becerra in the fight to keep California moving forward.
Xavier has spent his career fighting for our values and standing up to Donald Trump — as a Congressman, as California Attorney General, as HHS Secretary, and soon, as our next Governor. He’s taken on tough fights, defending our rights and freedoms in court and winning landmark victories to protect affordable healthcare, workers, and Dreamers.
Right now, our state is facing immense challenges: budgets are stretched thin by an ongoing affordability crisis, while Trump and his administration continue their relentless attacks. From public health to consumer protection, they’re actively working to undermine the progress we’ve made.
California needs proven leaders at the helm — and Xavier Becerra has the experience, judgment, and record of results to meet this moment.
Over the next 146 days, Republicans are going to spend millions of dollars to attempt to gain power here and weaken our leaders. Following the cues of their corrupt and brazenly lawless President, we know we can expect baseless attacks, bare-faced lies, and endless disinformation to distract voters from what’s at stake.
We need to be ready to not just win in November, but to deliver a decisive victory that sends a clear message: California will never back down.
We can’t take a single vote for granted, so I’m asking personally: will you split a donation between Xavier Becerra’s campaign for Governor and my campaign for Attorney General today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26-xb?amount=50]

We are diverse, resilient, and deeply proud to be the Golden State. And in this November’s elections, we will stand up for our values, protect our communities, and defend justice for everyone who calls this state home.

My name is Cait Conley, and I am running against Mike Lawler in NY-17. I’m a proud fourth-generation Hudson Valley native from a blue-collar family. After graduating from West Point, I spent 16 years as an active duty Army officer, deploying six times overseas to keep America safe. Now, I’m running for Congress in one of the toughest battleground districts in the entire country. This is one of only three House districts nationwide that split their ticket for Kamala Harris and a Republican member of Congress. Lawler is beatable — but only if we go toe-to-toe with him and communicate with voters across the district. Mike Lawler has beaten politicians before. He’s never beaten someone like me.
I am under no illusions that this race is going to be easy. Mike Lawler has a massive fundraising head start on us, and last cycle, Elon Musk invested more money in this race than in anywhere else nationwide.
But in the special operations community, we have a saying: “Run to the sound of the guns.”
It means we take the tough fights head-on. That’s what I’ve done for my entire career. And that’s what we’re doing in this race.

The **FIFA World Cup 2026TM Fan Zone Experience** on the National Mall will bring the excitement and global spirit of soccer to the nation’s capital during America’s 250th anniversary year.
Set among the monuments and memorials that tell America’s story, the experience will welcome families, fans, and visitors for live match viewing during scheduled operating dates.
From first-time fans to lifelong supporters, this National Mall experience will celebrate world-class competition, unity, freedom, and the enduring American spirit.
[RSVP Now! RSVP now to reserve your place at this Freedom 250 signature celebration.](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
